quick: Elemental iron 60 to 120 mg once daily or on alternate days; children 3 mg/kg/day
summary: Ferrous fumarate contains about 33% elemental iron (200 mg = 66 mg iron). Once-daily or alternate-day dosing improves absorption and tolerance.

dosage.d: Elemental iron 60 to 120 mg once daily or on alternate days; children 3 mg/kg/day

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Nutritional supplement; clinical effects are modest or unproven.

absolute: Anaemia not due to iron deficiency

preg: Recommended in pregnancy at national doses
lact: Dietary amounts are safe; supplement doses not established

moderate: Antacids, calcium, PPIs, tea: reduce absorption
Iron reduces absorption of levothyroxine, tetracyclines, quinolones, levodopa, mycophenolate

serious: Fatal poisoning in children (keep out of reach)

counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: Iron poisoning: assess elemental iron mg/kg; above 60 mg/kg is potentially lethal. Desferrioxamine for severe toxicity.
